channel.title: Beatwick — Every city has a sound.
channel.description: Scene reports from 30 music cities: the scenes, the rooms, the tracks actually moving.

item.title: London Is Still the World's A&R Desk
item.description: Grime grew up, drill went global, and every label on earth still shops for sounds in London first.

item.title: City Pop Never Died. It Just Moved to Your Algorithm.
item.description: A 1984 B-side conquered YouTube. Now Tokyo's new wave rides the same current.

item.title: Nobody Does Live Like Mexico City
item.description: The biggest, loudest crowds on earth sing louder than the PA.

item.title: Techno Is Berlin's Civic Religion
item.description: The city treats its clubs like churches. The door policy is the liturgy.

item.title: Baile Funk Is the Loudest Party on Earth
item.description: 150 BPM, favela-born, now Brazil's dominant pop export.
